chaves.panel.assetLibrary.notice: Gemini picks from here and never invents an asset (ADR-004). An unapproved item doesn't enter the prompt, and a map that depends on it won't go live. With one approved sky, every generated map comes out with the same sky — that's not the model repeating, it's the model choosing among one.
chaves.panel.assetLibrary.publishHint: Draws the missing images, uploads them to Roblox and records the assetId. Costs no Robux. Needs {chave} in {arquivo}.

chaves.panel.language.label: Language
chaves.panel.license.adviceActive: All set. The license is confirmed once, when the session starts, and holds for the whole live — nothing from Kora sits in the gift's path.
chaves.panel.license.adviceBadKey: The key you just pasted was not accepted. The license already saved on this machine, if there was one, still holds — what you see here is the answer about the new key.
chaves.panel.license.adviceCancelled: The subscription was cancelled, so this key no longer works. Talk to Kora to reactivate it, or paste another key below.
chaves.panel.license.adviceExpired: The paid period ended. Renew with Kora and paste the new key below — everything you set up stays where it is.
chaves.panel.license.adviceLoadFailed: I couldn't read this installation's license. The bridge may be down — check that it is running and try again. Nothing on disk was changed.
chaves.panel.license.adviceNoLicense: A fresh install starts like this, and that is not an error. Paste the key Kora emailed you below to activate this machine.
chaves.panel.license.adviceUnknown: We couldn't reach Kora right now. This is not a problem with your license or your account: it may be this machine's connection, or Kora being down. Try again once the connection is back.
chaves.panel.license.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate now? The next live won't start until you paste the key again.
chaves.panel.license.deactivateHint: Forgets the key on this computer without cancelling anything at Kora. It is how you move the license to another machine.
chaves.panel.license.graceUntil: Keeps working until {quando} while Kora doesn't answer.
chaves.panel.license.keyHint: The key stays on this machine only and is sent back to Kora at startup to re-confirm it. It never shows in full on this screen: the panel sits on a second monitor during the live.
chaves.panel.license.pasteKeyLabel: Paste the key Kora sent you
chaves.panel.license.reasonBadKey: Kora didn't recognize this key. Check that it was pasted in full, with no extra spaces.
chaves.panel.license.reasonCancelled: Kora replied that this subscription was cancelled.
chaves.panel.license.reasonExpired: Kora replied that this license's paid period has ended.
chaves.panel.license.reasonGraceOver: The grace period is over: the license has gone too long without being re-confirmed with Kora.
chaves.panel.license.reasonKoraDown: We couldn't reach Kora on the last attempt.
chaves.panel.license.reasonNoKey: No key has been activated on this machine yet.
chaves.panel.license.title: License
chaves.panel.liveAccount.lockedNotice: The session is running. Stop it to switch streams.
chaves.panel.liveAccount.missingAccount: Without an account set, the session won't start.
chaves.panel.liveAccount.title: Stream account
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.allMapped: every gift landed in a preset slot
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.bindHint: Puts "{gift}" in the first free slot
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.blindAlarm: Panel blind — no feed from the bridge. Everything below is past: a gift arriving now won't show here.
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.blindAlarmSince: Panel blind {since} — no feed from the bridge. Everything below is past: a gift arriving now won't show here.
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.emptyRunning: Session running, no gift yet. The first one to arrive shows here.
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.emptyStopped: Session stopped. Nothing arrives until Start.
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.latencySamples: Last {n} latencies measured, from oldest to newest: {samples}.
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.noCombats: no combat in the latest events
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.shortEffectHint: Combat closed on timeout: net with a short effect, no full animation (ADR-012.6).
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.tieExplanation: Both sides canceled out and nobody moved. The game didn't freeze — worth narrating.
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.title: Live monitor
chaves.panel.liveMonitor.winnerAnimationNote: Played the winning side's animation: whoever sent the other side didn't see their own animation.
chaves.panel.liveSummary.allMatched: Every gift that arrived matched a slot.
chaves.panel.liveSummary.animationsHint: Animations played. Fewer than the gifts: those arriving together fight and come out as one (ADR-012).
chaves.panel.liveSummary.giftsReceivedHint: The Phase 0 gate number: how much the audience sent.
chaves.panel.liveSummary.interrupted: Interrupted — the bridge dropped before Stop
chaves.panel.liveSummary.noSlotMatched: No gift matched a slot in this stream.
chaves.panel.liveSummary.noSummary: This session started at {quando} and was never closed — the bridge stopped before Stop. Without Stop there is no summary: it is what closes the count.
chaves.panel.liveSummary.title: Stream summary
chaves.panel.logs.emptyState: Nothing logged yet. Whatever the bridge does shows up here.
chaves.panel.lookPicker.emptyState: No look saved yet — that is normal at the start. Build one in the wardrobe inside the game (Roblox Studio, private experience) so it shows up here.
chaves.panel.lookPicker.loadError: Could not load the saved looks.
chaves.panel.lookPicker.lockedNotice: Session running: switching looks does not apply mid-match (ADR-011). It takes effect at the start of the next session or the next checkpoint respawn.
chaves.panel.lookPicker.partTitle: Roblox catalog item #{assetId} — icon arrives when the wardrobe fetches the catalog
chaves.panel.lookPicker.title: Character look
chaves.panel.mapPreview.emptyState: No map selected. Generate or pick a map to see the preview.
chaves.panel.mapPreview.gaugeHint: ADR-009 ceiling: jumpHeight × 0.7. The fuller it is, the tighter the jump — always within jump reach, with no gift at all.
chaves.panel.mapPreview.gaugeOverflow: Over the ADR-009 ceiling — see the reason at the top: this map isn't climbable without a gift.
chaves.panel.mapPreview.readinessIntro: This spec is valid, but it can't go live until this is resolved:
chaves.panel.mapPreview.readinessNoReason: No reason reported by the bridge.
chaves.panel.mapPreview.readinessUnknown: Readiness not evaluated yet for this map.
chaves.panel.matchControl.offlineWarning: With Roblox down, these commands get dropped by the long-poll and go nowhere.
chaves.panel.matchControl.reloadMapHint: Rebuilds the tower with the chosen map, without stopping the session.
chaves.panel.matchControl.resetScoreHint: Resets the scoreboard. The race continues where it is.
chaves.panel.matchControl.restartHint: Sends the avatar back to the base of the tower. The scoreboard stays.
chaves.panel.matchControl.title: Match controls
chaves.panel.modePicker.label: Mode
chaves.panel.modePicker.lockedHint: Stop the session to change mode.
chaves.panel.movementTable.deltaFromSlotTitle: Comes from the slot, on the Live page
chaves.panel.movementTable.emptyCatalog: The catalog is empty. Refresh the TikTok list on the Live page, when you pick a gift.
chaves.panel.movementTable.explanation: How far the tower moves with each gift from the stream. The number comes from a formula — gift coins × multiplier — and you change whatever you want, one by one. Gifts sitting in the slots are not part of this formula: they have their own animation and delta, on the Live page.
chaves.panel.movementTable.floorsPerCoinNote: 10 means: a 1-coin gift goes up 10 floors.
chaves.panel.movementTable.footerNote: Applies from the next gift on. Switching preset mid-stream switches the table too.
chaves.panel.movementTable.intensityNote: Applies to every gift in the table.
chaves.panel.movementTable.invertTitle: Flips the sign: what goes up now goes down
chaves.panel.movementTable.noPreset: Pick or create a preset to build the gift table.
chaves.panel.movementTable.previewSaved: The numbers below are what the table WOULD do. Turn it on and save to make them count in the stream.
chaves.panel.movementTable.previewUnsaved: This preset has no table yet. The numbers below are the formula already done — turn it on and save to make them count in the stream.
chaves.panel.movementTable.sweepWarnMany: {n} gifts on their own already cover the whole tower ({total} floors). Nothing breaks — the game stops at the ends —, but the race ends on one gift. Lower the multiplier or edit those gifts.
chaves.panel.movementTable.sweepWarnOne: {n} gift on its own already covers the whole tower ({total} floors). Nothing breaks — the game stops at the ends —, but the race ends on one gift. Lower the multiplier or edit those gifts.
chaves.panel.movementTable.title: Gifts: up and down
chaves.panel.movementTable.toggleNote: Off, only the 6 slots move the tower and the rest counts as unmapped again. What you edited here stays saved.
chaves.panel.openGame.afterOpen: When Studio opens: hit {action}. The rest is already set up.
chaves.panel.openGame.ready: Studio opening with the game built and the bridge already configured. Just hit Play.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.camParam: height of the cam area, in % of the screen; the rest is the game. Nothing is drawn over the cam, so getting this wrong shifts everything and never covers your face
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.cutscenesDescription: Plays the win or loss video when the round ends. Transparent the rest of the time.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.emptyFolder: No videos yet. Put an {mp4} or {webm} in {pasta} — name with lowercase, numbers and hyphens only — and check again.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.hudDescription: Scoreboard, gift captions, the round's up × down race, portal, countdown and the new follower alert. The tower bar is the only thing the game still draws, because it has to move on every step. No donor and no coins here — what shows up is the gift and what it does to the tower.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.ignoredFiles: Off the naming pattern, and so off the list: {lista}. Only lowercase, numbers and hyphens, ending in {mp4} or {webm}.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.inUseTitle: Cutscene used by the active preset
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.intro: Transparent pages that sit on top of the game capture and the cam. Roblox takes neither video nor TikTok gift icons; that's why they live in OBS or TikTok LIVE Studio, not inside the game.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.missingWarning: The active preset points to a video that isn't in the folder. Without it the cutscene doesn't play and nothing warns you: OBS shows a transparent rectangle. Put the file there, or change the pick in Scoreboard gifts.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.stepAlwaysOn: Don't tick “shut down when not visible”: they need to stay listening.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.stepLiveStudio: In TikTok LIVE Studio: {action}, one for each URL. Paste the whole URL, with the {ext} at the end — without it LIVE Studio answers “Enter the correct URL”.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.stepObs: In OBS: {action}, one for each URL.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.stepOrder: Keep both {above} the Roblox capture and the cam in the list.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.stepSize: Width and height the same as your scene (1080 × 1920 in vertical).
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.stretchParam: turns off the pre-stretch. The page is 9:16; if the source renders it in landscape (LIVE Studio's “Link” does) and the item is stretched to fill the scene, it pre-stretches itself to come out right. Turn it off only if your source is already 9:16
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.studioHint: Where each HUD piece sits on screen is set on the {studio} page: there the scoreboard, the captions and the rest drag around the scene. Saving there adjusts the source already open in OBS — no need to reload it.
chaves.panel.overlayPanel.title: Stream overlays
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.anchorWarning: pinned {ancora} today: the first move pins it by left and top, and it jumps.
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.boxAriaLabel: {rotulo}, at x {x}% and y {y}%. Arrow keys move it.
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.camOverlap: Touching the cam band: {lista}. Nothing is drawn over the cam on purpose (ADR-015) — there the element ends up behind your face.
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.emptyResponse: The bridge returned empty for the overlay layout.
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.intro: Drag each HUD piece to its place in your scene. The stage is the whole vertical screen (9:16), the same one the OBS source draws. Only what you move is saved — the rest stays where the page already puts it.
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.noCamHeight: The bridge didn't send the cam height. The band shows no shading and nothing warns you if a box lands on it (ADR-015).
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.noCatalog: The bridge didn't send the element catalog. Without it there's nothing to position.
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.nothingMoved: nothing moved yet: the overlay is at default
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.resetOneTitle: Reset this element to the page default
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.saveHint: On save, the source already open in OBS adjusts itself — no need to reload anything there.
chaves.panel.overlayStudio.title: Overlay studio
chaves.panel.presetEditor.duplicateGift: Repeated gift: {lista}. The bridge rejects a preset with the same gift in two slots.
chaves.panel.presetEditor.emptyState: No preset loaded. Pick or create one to set up the slots.
chaves.panel.presetEditor.seedCatalog: The catalog hasn't been collected from this account yet, so the panel doesn't recognize this preset's gifts — the preset is fine. Connect to the live once, or click “Refresh from TikTok” when picking a gift, and the names and values show up.
chaves.panel.presetEditor.slotLimit: The preset hit the {n} slots the bridge accepts. Remove one to add another gift.
chaves.panel.presetManager.idEmpty: That name leaves nothing usable for the file id. Use at least one letter or number.
chaves.panel.presetManager.idTaken: A preset with the id {id} already exists. Pick another name.
chaves.panel.presetManager.lockedNotice: The session is running. Creating and deleting presets is pre-stream work — what you can do now is switch the active preset, in the top bar (R7).
chaves.panel.presetManager.title: Presets
chaves.panel.rules.burstWarning: {platforms} platforms for {coins} coins is a lot for a cheap gift — it arrives in bursts.
chaves.panel.rules.burstWarningOneCoin: {platforms} platforms for {coins} coin is a lot for a cheap gift — it arrives in bursts.
chaves.panel.rules.directionDownWithPositiveDel: Down animation with a positive delta: the character goes up while the effect goes down.
chaves.panel.rules.directionUpWithNegativeDelta: Up animation with a negative delta: the character goes down while the effect goes up.
chaves.panel.rules.letdownWarning: {coins} coins to move {platforms} platforms will disappoint whoever sends it.
chaves.panel.rules.letdownWarningOnePlatform: {coins} coins to move {platforms} platform will disappoint whoever sends it.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.cutsceneGoneWarning: That video is no longer in {folder}. Without it, nothing plays and nothing warns.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.explainer: These gifts don't animate the character: they end the round and score a point. A {loss} gift breaks the portal instantly, without spending its health. Sent in a burst, it's worth one round per repeat — and they're charged one by one, each fall with its own count. The {cutscene} is the video the overlay plays in OBS when the round ends, on top of the game.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.ignoredFiles: Off the naming pattern, and therefore off the list: {files}.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.lossWhen: The portal breaking, or getting one of these gifts.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.noVideosInFolder: No video in {folder}. Put an {mp4} or {webm} there — name with lowercase, numbers and hyphen only — and search again.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.portalHint: In {unit}, the same unit as the delta: a gift that drops 20 floors takes 20. Only negative gifts hurt.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.title: Scoreboard gifts
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.videosFromFolder: Videos come from {folder}: {mp4} or {webm}, name with lowercase, numbers and hyphen only.
chaves.panel.scoreEditor.winWhen: Reaching the top, or getting one of these gifts.
chaves.panel.sessionBar.gameOfflineWarning: Roblox stopped responding. Gifts arriving now are being discarded, not queued — reopen the experience to make them count again.
chaves.panel.sessionBar.liveReconnectingWarning: The bridge lost the connection to the stream and is retrying. Nothing is made up meanwhile — a gift sent now only counts once it reconnects.
chaves.panel.sessionBar.presetFromNextGift: · applies from the next gift on
chaves.panel.sessionBar.startNote: Start is the confirmation that the stream begins to count for real.
chaves.panel.sessionBar.stopNote: Stops the session and discards all viewer data from the log.
chaves.panel.sessionBar.testNote: Runs with fixture events, without touching the real stream.
chaves.panel.sessionHistory.emptyState: No streams recorded yet. Every session closed with Stop becomes a row here, already reduced to the summary — per-event detail is discarded on close (F5).
chaves.panel.sessionHistory.title: Past streams
chaves.panel.skinGallery.emptyState: Gallery empty. The wardrobe will have nothing to offer.
chaves.panel.skinGallery.explanation: Roblox nicks whose skins the wardrobe wears as a base. Check the image before adding.
chaves.panel.skinGallery.title: Skin gallery
chaves.panel.slotCard.deltaRule: Delta is a whole number, and never 0.
chaves.panel.slotCard.emptyExplanation: An empty slot is valid. A gift left out doesn't vanish: it still moves the tower by the movement table. The slot is what gives it its own animation, delta and intensity.
chaves.panel.slotCard.giftFromLive: name and value come from the live
chaves.panel.slotCard.leftoverExtra: This position is left over from a removed extra. It goes away on its own when the extras above it are gone.
chaves.panel.slotCard.overlayAria: Slot {n} shows in the overlay legend
chaves.panel.victoryNotice.gameOffline: Roblox is offline: the command would be discarded. Reopen the experience first.
chaves.panel.victoryNotice.noAutoRestart: The run doesn't restart by itself — an upward gift has nowhere left to go.
chaves.panel.victoryNotice.reachedTop: The character reached the top of the map.
chaves.panel.victoryNotice.title: Top of the tower
chaves.panel.worldPicker.explainer: Pick the sky and the platforms. With {more} texture they take turns step by step, and the steps stop being tinted by the palette — the variety comes from the texture. It goes live as soon as you build.
chaves.panel.worldPicker.gameOfflineNote: The game is offline: the tower rises when Roblox reconnects.
chaves.panel.worldPicker.noSkies: No approved sky. Use “Generate and upload what's missing” in the Library, below.
chaves.panel.worldPicker.pickAtLeastOne: Pick at least one to be able to build.
chaves.panel.worldPicker.shapeStairsHint: Separate steps rising along the perimeter of a square. The player jumps.
chaves.panel.worldPicker.shapeWalkwayHint: Steps joined to one another, in a straight line. The player walks up.
chaves.panel.worldPicker.title: Build world
